title: The Multiverse
description: Other branes, other constants, other universes, and a way to reach them.

puzzle.goal: A homogeneous universe with scale factor a(t) contains matter-energy of density ρ, has spatial curvature k and a constant vacuum energy Λ. Write the square of its relative expansion rate from energy conservation in general relativity.
puzzle.name: Friedmann equation with cosmological constant
puzzle.ask: When Λ dominates, ȧ/a = H is constant and a ∝ e^{Ht}, so a region's volume, and the number of Hubble volumes it holds, grows as e^{3Ht}. Find that factor after H·t = 2 (H = 0.5, t = 4 in matching units).
puzzle.method: Apply Einstein's equations to the uniform metric (or Newtonian energy of an expanding sphere plus curvature and vacuum terms).
